reviews.title: Great for any small form factor builder/enthusiast, not just handhelds.
reviews.comment: This is a really handy little gadget to have on hand when upgrading storage in any small device, be it a handheld as it's advertised or a laptop, a small form factor desktop, a RasPi-like SBC, etc. The ribbon cable allows you to put the upgraded/elongated at whatever angle you need to fit it together. It connects fine and works just as described. I didn't do a before/after speed/latency test on the same drive to test if that affects it at all, but it seems to work 100% like it's not even there. I would recommend just picking it up to have on hand as a troubleshooting tool also, you never know when you need to verify functionality with a drive that may not fit natively on the device's motherboard.
reviews.author: Rochelle

reviews.title: NVME 2230 and 2242 to 2280 SSD Adapter
reviews.comment: Just as it says on the tin, this adapter will allow you to use NVME 2280 SSDs (big ones) in places that were only designed for 2230 and 2242 (small, smaller) ones.  This particular adapter is targeting the steam deck (LCD) and the ribbon cable is the perfect length to use it there, but I’m using mine on an older motherboard to add newer extra storage to extend the life of that system.  It’s not an active device, so there’s really nothing that can go wrong with it either.
reviews.author: Tim G.

reviews.title: Was able to add 4tb to my deck (with thermal pads)
reviews.comment: This NVMe extension adapter fit properly in the Steam Deck once installed, and the flex cable length was sufficient for routing within the available space. The board and connector felt well made, and the adapter allowed the use of a larger, full-size SSD rather than being limited to shorter formats. Overall construction appeared solid for a specialty expansion component like this. Using the adapter made it possible to significantly increase storage capacity compared to the stock configuration. With higher-capacity drives, heat management is something to be mindful of, but the adapter itself did not introduce any immediate issues during use. For users looking to expand storage beyond the original constraints, it functions as intended.
reviews.author: Guy With a Multimeter

reviews.title: Works great for my Legion Go
reviews.comment: This is a great plug and play adapter. I just found a video online for installing and using this, and it was easy, fast, and I had no problems with it.
reviews.author: Lara Sorensen

reviews.title: Reliable SSD adapter for Steam Deck and Legion Go to expand storage easily
reviews.comment: I picked up this M.2 SSD adapter for my Steam Deck to expand storage, and it’s been a game changer. The adapter allows me to use larger NVMe drives, which was perfect since the built-in storage on the handheld gets filled quickly with games. The build quality is solid, and the FPC cable feels sturdy enough to handle regular use without worrying about damage. Installation was straightforward, though you do need to be careful with the small connectors to avoid bending pins. Once installed, the system recognized the new SSD immediately, and transfer speeds have been consistent with PCIe 3.0 standards. The ability to use 2230, 2242, or 2280 drives makes it versatile if you already have spare drives lying around. Overall, it’s a practical solution for anyone looking to expand storage on a Steam Deck or Legion Go without replacing the internal drive. Very convenient and reliable. Photos are accurate of the product.
